title: TRAINING SIMULATION
content:
Hi There I'm looking for some help with simulation training and some one on one learning over teams can anyone help. I'm new to CLO but have V stitcher experience. 

When simulating large pattern pieces I'm getting a lot of collision and need some help with understand the arrangement and why me back piece is discoloured. Also need to understand how to make the fabric double. So the garment is fully lined. and to increase the weight of the fabric. Would appreciate some help. 

* * *

## 

![af0286ab6f2f4191b2f91c20847f209d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/455d3cf0447140a38234df2c999bdac3/images/af0286ab6f2f4191b2f91c20847f209dCL136347%20CLUB%20L%20BLOCK%20SIZE%208.pacx%20USED%20SIZE%204%20AVATAR%20MONDAY%20NIGHT%205.png)

Thanks Vikki


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi Lucile I have found your links to my issues very helpful. The garments we are doing at the moment there is alot of gathering in them. Is there a better way to show up the gathering, I have tried many times with the elastic and with an extra stitch row, have a look at my screen shots . Thank you :)

Comment 2: Hi Lucile could you explain or advise on how to mark a seam allowance onto and DXF pattern which already has the seam allowance built into the pattern. I will be working with many hand patterns from other people which already have the seam allowance on. With CLO how do you do this. Thanks Vikki
Reply 1: Hey Vikki,To add seam allowances, you can check this video: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/455d3cf0447140a38234df2c999bdac3 remove existing seam allowances, you can select the internal lines and righ-click > cut then delete the extra patterns/seam allowances.

title: Long Collar Midi Shoulder Pad Dress
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/98d61e3616b5432e9d0a797d16e483c6/images/7333183758f341a69b2216d0a4fc02baLong%20Collar%20Midi%20Shoulder%20Pad%20Dress_Pose%20.jpg)

* * *

This dress is a sophisticated, vintage-inspired long-sleeve midi dress in a vibrant turquoise shade. It features structured shoulder pads, giving it a bold, powerful silhouette reminiscent of classic tailored designs. The collar is elongated and tied into a soft bow, with a keyhole cutout just beneath for a subtle touch of elegance. The bodice is fitted with decorative stitching and button detailing running down the center, enhancing the waistline. The skirt flares out gently from the waist, creating a flowy, graceful look. This style combines vintage charm with a modern, polished vibe — perfect for formal gatherings or a statement work outfit.
content_description: Discover the elegance of our vintage-inspired turquoise midi dress, featuring structured shoulder pads and sophisticated detailing for a bold yet graceful look perfect for any formal occasion.
